l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). I chikamu, pakati pezviitiko zvinoitika B, apo A inoitikawo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-12.title: Nheyo ipi inosarudza kana infinite geometric series inosvika?
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.goal: Tsvaga kuti ndeipi nheyo (ruzivo) inodikanwa chaizvo kuti uzive kana infinite geometric series inosvika, uye utsanangure kuti wakasarudza sei.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.material: Chii chinosarudza kana infinite geometric series a+ar+ar²+… (a≠0) inosvika?
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.a: Kana term yekutanga a iri pasi pe 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.a: Kana a=0.5 uye r=1, mazwi anoramba ari 0.5, saka inoparadzana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.b: Kana term yekutanga a iri yakanaka
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange a yakanaka, inoparadzana kana r=2, uye kunyange isina kunaka, inosvika kana r=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.c: Kana absolute value yeratio inofanana r iri pasi pe 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.explain: Kana a≠0, geometric series inosvika kana |r|<1 uye huwandu hwayo ndi a/(1−r). Kana |r|≥1, inoparadzana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s2.model.0: Kuti mazwi aende ku 0, |r|<1 inodikanwa, uye ipapo mapartial sums anosvika padyo ne a/(1−r), saka saizi yeratio inofanana ndiyo nheyo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s2.model.1: Kuchinja a hakuchinji kana inoconverge, saka a haisi criterion. Kana absolute value ye r i shoma kupfuura 1 ndiko kunosarudza convergence.

l-m-h3-b0d09-02.material: Pane mapoinzi maviri akagadzikana F ne F′ nepoinzi inofamba P. Kana ukaisa mamiriro pamadistance PF ne PF′, ellipse kana hyperbola inodhirowa. Tsvaga mamiriro anopatsanura mamwe maviri.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.a: Kana PF iri refu kana pfupi kupfuura PF′

l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.b: Kuti inhamba yakazara hazvina chekuita nemhando yecurve.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.c: Kana poinzi P iri pamusoro pe x-axis
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.c: Poinzi kunyange iri kupi, haina chekuita nemhando yecurve.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.d: Kana ihuwandu hwe PF ne PF′ kana absolute value yemusiyano wadzo
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.explain: Ellipse iboka rapoinzi apo PF+PF′ yakagadzikana, uye hyperbola iboka rapoinzi apo |PF−PF′| yakagadzikana. Kuti ihuwandu kana musiyano kunopatsanura mamwe maviri.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s2.model.0: Kana huwandu hwakagadzikana iellipse, uye kana absolute value yemusiyano yakagadzikana ihyperbola, saka nzira iyoyo yekuverenga ndiyo muyero.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s2.model.1: Dzimwe sarudzo hadzigoni kuchinja mhando yecurve. Tsanangudzo dzinopatsanurwa nehuwandu kana musiyano, saka ndiwo muyero.

l-m-h3-b0c46-14.s.s2.model.0: Semitones 12 ndi nguva 2, saka semitones 7 ndi 2 kusimba 7/12, anenge nguva 1.5, saka 262×1.5≈393Hz.

l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.0: Sezvo nzvimbo ye orthogonal projection = nzvimbo × cosθ, 20×0.87≈17. Chimiro chichitenderera zvikuru, mumvuri unova mudiki, saka uri pasi pe 20.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.1: 30° yakatenderera zvishoma chete kupfuura 0°, saka mumvuri unodzikira zvishoma chete. Ndosaka anenge 17, anenge ari pasi zvishoma pe 20, anokodzera.

l-m-h3-b0d10-07.title: Hyperbola i yakareba zvakadini pa x=3?
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.goal: Fungidzira y-coordinate yepoinzi pa hyperbola kuti usarudze hukuru kana huwandu hwakakodzera, uye utsanangure kufunga kwako.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.material: Fungidzira y-coordinate (positive) yepoinzi ine x = 3 pa right branch ye hyperbola x² − y²/16 = 1. Shandisa square numbers, pasina calculator.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.a: Kana y=16, ipapo y²=256, iyo i hombe zvikuru kuenzaniswa ne 128.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.b: y² i 128. Square root haina kutorwa.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.c: Kubva ku y²/16=8, y²=128, uye y haisi 8.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.explain: Pa x=3, y²/16=9−1=8, saka y²=128. Sezvo 11²=121<128<144=12², y iri pakati pe 11 ne 12.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.0: y²=128 iri pakati pe 11²=121 ne 12²=144, saka y i yakawanda zvishoma kupfuura 11, anenge 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.1: Asymptote y=4x i 12 pa x=3, uye curve i pasi zvishoma payo, saka i anenge 11, padyo ne 12.

l-m-h3-b0d10-19.material: Pane vector a ine saizi 5 nevector b ine saizi 2. Kona iri pakati pazvo haizivikanwi. Shandisa kufungidzira kubvisa kukosha kwaisingagoni kuva a·b.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.r.b: Kana dzakamira pamakona akarurama, cos90°=0, saka dot product ndi 0.

l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s2.model.0: a·b=5·2·cosθ=10cosθ, uye cosθ haigoni kupfuura 1, saka dot product ndi 10 kana pasi uye haigoni kuva 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s2.model.1: Munzira imwe chete dot product ndiyo huru zvakanyanya pa 10, saka 11 haigoni kuitika, uye zvese kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10 zvinogoneka.

l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.1: Kana dot product iri 0.8, saka cosθ=0.8, uye kona painokura, cos inova diki, saka kona yakasungirirwa pakati pekukosha kuviri kwekutarisa, 30° ne 45°.

l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaunganidza p kudivi rimwe, 100+10=1.5p+p, saka 110=2.5p uye p=44.

l-m-h3-b0c34-17.s.s2.model.1: Kana ukaendesa −p kudivi rerudyi, inowedzerwa ku 1.5p ikava 2.5p, saka gadzirisa kuita p=110÷2.5=44.

l-m-h3-b0c35-20.goal: Teverera danho nedanho gadziriso ye expected value yemutambo wedhisi, kana cheni yayo yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, uye utsvage uye ugadzirise nzvimbo yekutanga yakaenda zvisina kunaka.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.material: Kanda dhisi kamwe. Kana nhamba i even, unogamuchira (nhamba)×100 won; kana i odd, unobhadhara 200 won. Gadziriso: 1) Mikana ye even ne odd i 1/2 imwe neimwe 2) Kana i even, unogamuchira 400 won pavhareji 3) Expected value=400−200=200 won 4) Kutamba ka100 kunowana anenge 20,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.r.a: Kune nhamba dzeven 3 uye nhamba dzeodd 3, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.o.b: Danho 2: 400 won pavhareji kana i even
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.r.d: Uku kuverenga kwakaitwa mushure mekushandisa mutengo weDanho 3, saka hazvisi nzvimbo yekutanga yakaenda zvisina kunaka.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s1.explain: Unofanira kuwanza nemikana. 1/2×400−1/2×200=100 won, uye kutamba ka100 kunopa anenge 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s2.model.0: Haina kururama nekuti Danho 3 harina kuwanza nemukana 1/2 wemamiriro maviri; gadziriso i 200−100=100 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-20.s.s2.model.1: Expected value i huwandu hwemitengo yakawanzwa nemikana, saka 400×1/2−200×1/2=100 won, uye Danho 4 rinochinjawo kuita 10,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c35-26.material: Iyi igadziriso yekuchengetedza 200 ×10,000 won kwemakore 3 pa 3% annual compound interest. 1) Mushure megore 1: 200×1.03=206 2) Mushure memakore 2: 206+200×0.03=212 3) Mushure memakore 3: 212+200×0.03=218 4) Huwandu hwekuibva i 218 ×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s1.r.c: Kukanganisa kumwe chete kwakaenderera, asi nzvimbo yekutanga yakaenda zvisina kunaka i Danho 2.

l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s1.explain: Ne compound interest, interest inowanawo interest. Mushure memakore 2 i 206×1.03=212.18, uye mushure memakore 3 i anenge 218.5 ×10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-26.s.s2.model.0: Haina kururama nekuti muDanho 2 interest yakawedzerwa ku 200 yekutanga chete. Wedzera 3% ku 206 uye ugadzirise kuita 212.18.

l-m-h3-b0c36-20.title: Kuongorora zvinoyerwa zvakawanikwa kubva pa confusion matrix
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.goal: Tevedza mhinduro inowana zvinoyerwa kubva pa confusion matrix, kana cheni yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, nenzira, wobva wawana uye wagadzirisa nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.material: Mhedzisiro yemabvunzo 200: vanhu vanorwara 40 vakawanikwa zvakarurama semhedzisiro yakanaka, vanhu vanorwara 10 vakarasika, vanhu vasingarwari 20 vakatongwa zvisizvo semhedzisiro yakanaka, uye vanhu vasingarwari 130 vakawanikwa zvakarurama. Tsvaga mutsetse wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro yemudzidzi mumwe.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.o.d: ④ Recall iri pasi, saka vanhu vanorwara vakawanda vakarasika
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.d: Mhedziso iyi inobva pakukosha kwakanganisa mu ③. Pane mutsetse wakatangira wakanganisa.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.explain: Denominator ye recall ndiwo huwandu chaihwo hwevanhu vanorwara, 40+10=50. 40/50=80%, uye 40+20 ndiwo huwandu hwakafungidzirwa kuva vakanaka, hunoshandiswa pa precision.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.0: Recall ndicho chikamu chakawanikwa pakati pevanhu vanorwara chaizvo, saka denominator inofanira kuva 40+10=50, asi 20 yakawedzerwa uye izvo hazvina kururama; kukosha kwakarurama ndi 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.1: 40+20 yakashandiswa mu ③ ndiwo huwandu hwakafungidzirwa kuva vakanaka, saka ndiyo denominator ye precision. Gadzirisa recall kuva 40/50=80%.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.material: Iyi mhinduro yemudzidzi inowana cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|) ye a=(3,4) ne b=(4,−3). Tsvaga mutsara wekutanga wakanganisa.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.explain: |b|=√(4²+(−3)²)=√25=5. Sikweya inogara iri positive zvisinei nesaini, saka unofanira kuwedzera.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.0: Sezvo (−3)²=9, |b| ndi√(16+9)=5, asi mu③ 9 yakabviswa ikava √7, saka ③ ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.1: Kuita sikweya zvikamu kunozviita positive zvose, saka unofanira kuwedzera, asi yakabviswa, saka gadzirisa ③ kuita 5.

l-m-h3-b0c37-18.material: Tsvaga mutsara wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro inowana 95% confidence interval yemean yepopulation (mean yesantioni ± 2×standard error) kana standard deviation yepopulation iri 16, hukuru hwesantioni ndi64, uye mean yesantioni ndi50.

l-m-h3-b0c37-19.goal: Tevera madanho emhinduro inodifferentiate huwandu hwemasikweya ekukanganisa kuti iwane slope, kana cheni yayo yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, nenhevedzano, tsvaga pakatanga kukanganisa, uye ugadzirise.

l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.explain: Mu②, ma derivative emukati 2 ne3 e(2w−3)² ne(3w−7)² akasiiwa. Mutsara wakarurama ndi J'(w)=28w−58.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s2.model.0: Kana uchidifferentiate basa rakabatanidzwa, macoefficient 2 ne3 emutsara wemukati anowanzwa, asi akasiiwa mu②, saka ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s2.model.1: J'(w) yakarurama ndi2(w−2)+4(2w−3)+6(3w−7)=28w−58, saka ②, yakashaya kuwanza nemacoefficient, ndiyo nzvimbo yakanganisa.

l-m-h3-b0c46-20.goal: Teverera danho nedanho gadziriso inowana nhamba inosiya 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 3, 3 kana yagovaniswa ne 5, uye 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 7, kana cheni yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, kuti utsvage nzvimbo yekutanga yakaenda zvisina kunaka uye uigadzirise.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.material: Teverera gadziriso kubva muSunzi Suanjing. ①Nhamba diki zvikuru inosiya 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 3 uye 3 kana yagovaniswa ne 5 i 8 ②Nhamba dzakadaro dzinowedzera ne 3+5=8 nguva imwe neimwe: 8, 16, 24… ③Pakati pazvo, nhamba inosiya 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 7 i 16 ④Mhinduro i 16.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.r.a: 8÷3 inosiya remainder 2 uye 8÷5 inosiya remainder 3, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nhamba inosiya 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 7 i 16
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.r.c: Remainder 2 ye 16÷7 yakarurama, asi 16 i nhamba inobva pandandanda isina kururama.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.r.d: Remainder ye 16÷3 i 1. Chikonzero i ②.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s1.explain: Musiyano pakati pema common multiples e 3 ne 5 i least common multiple, 15. Pakati pe 8, 23, 38, …, nhamba inosiya 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 7 i 23.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s2.model.0: Musiyano apo ma remainders ekugovanisa ne 3 ne 5 anodzokororwa i least common multiple, 15, saka inofanira kuwedzera ne 15, kwete ne 8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-20.s.s2.model.1: Pakati pe 8, 23, 38…, nhamba yekutanga inosiya 2 kana yagovaniswa ne 7 i 23, saka mhinduro i 23, kwete 16.

l-m-h3-b0c47-18.material: Iyi mhinduro inowana greatest common divisor ye 252 ne 105. ① 252 = 105×2 + 42 ② 105 = 42×3 + 21 ③ 42 = 21×2 + 0 ④ Divisor 21, pamberi pechasara chisati chava 0, ndiyo greatest common divisor.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.r.d: Mhedziso yakarurama. 252 ne 105 zvese ndizvo zvakawanda za 21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.explain: 42×3+21=147, isiri 105. 105 = 42×2 + 21 yakarurama. Mhinduro yekupedzisira, 21, ichiri yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.0: 42×3+21=147 haipi 105, saka ② ndipo pakatanga kukanganisa. Inofanira kugadziriswa kuva 105 = 42×2 + 21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.1: Kuwedzera 42 ne 3 kunopa 126, saka chasara kubva pa 105 hachizova 21. 84, iri 42 yakawedzerwa ne 2, pamwe chete ne 21 inoita 105, saka ② inofanira kugadziriswa.

l-m-h3-b0c47-20.title: Kutsvaga golden ratio: mutsetse upi ndiwo kukanganisa kwekutanga?
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.goal: Tevedza nedanho mhinduro inowana golden ratio, apo rutivi rurefu runova nguva 1.618, kana cheni yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, uye utsvage uye ugadzirise pakatanga kukanganisa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.material: Kana rectangle ine rutivi rurefu x nerutivi rupfupi 1 ine golden ratio, saka x:1=(x+1):x. ① x² = x+1 ② x²−x−1=0 ③ x=(1±√5)/2 ④ Sezvo kureba kuri kwakanaka, x=(1−√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.a: Mu proportion, chibereko chemazwi emukati chakaenzana nechibereko chemazwi ekunze, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.b: Ndiyo equation x²=x+1 nezvose zvakaendeswa kurutivi rumwe, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.c: Kuisa a=1, b=−1, c=−1 mu quadratic formula kwakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.explain: (1−√5)/2 inenge −0.618, nhamba isina kunaka. Kureba ndiko kwakanaka, (1+√5)/2≈1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.0: √5≈2.236, saka (1−√5)/2 inenge −0.618, nhamba isina kunaka, uye haigoni kuva kureba. Gadzirisa kuva (1+√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.1: Kureba kwakanaka, saka unofanira kusarudza mudzi mukuru wemidzi miviri, (1+√5)/2≈1.618, asi ④ yakasarudza mudzi mudiki.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.a: Wanza mativi ose maviri ne a kuti uwane a²=ab
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.a: Kuwanza mativi ose maviri nenhamba imwe chete kwakanaka.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.b: Kubvisa nhamba imwe chete kumativi ose maviri kwakanaka.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.c: Patsanura mativi ose maviri ne (a−b) kuti uwane a+b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.d: Isa a=b mu a+b=b kuti uwane 2b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.d: Kuverenga kunoisa a=b kwakarurama. Dambudziko riri mumutsara wapfuura.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.explain: Kana a=b, saka a−b=0, saka izvi zvinopatsanura ne0. Kupatsanura ne0 hakubvumirwi.

l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.r.b: Kuisa radius yakachinjwa mufomula yevolume inzira yakarurama.

l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.explain: (2r)³=8r³. Kana kureba kukava nguva 2 huru, volume inova 2³=nguva 8, saka mhepo nguva 8 inodiwa.

l-m-h3-b0d10-08.material: Iyi igadziriso yekuwana hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 ine ma foci (±5, 0) uye transverse axis ine kureba 6. ① Transverse axis 2a=6, a=3 ② Focus c=5 ③ b²=a²+c²=9+25=34 ④ x²/9 − y²/34 = 1
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.a: Kureba kwe transverse axis i 2a, saka a=3 yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.d: Denominator 9 iri pasi pe x² yakarurama.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.explain: Kune hyperbola, c²=a²+b², saka b²=c²−a²=25−9=16. Equation i x²/9−y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.0: Hyperbola ine c²=a²+b², saka b²=c²−a² inofanira kuva 16. Kuinyora ne plus mu ③ hazvina kururama.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.1: Kana b²=34, ipapo c²=9+34=43, uye ma foci aisazova (±5,0). Saka 34 haina kururama uye 16 yakarurama.

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.material: Iyi igadziriso yekuwana k kuti mutsetse y = x + k ubate parabola y² = 4x. ① (x+k)² = 4x ② x² + (2k−4)x + k² = 0 ③ Unobata, saka D>0, ndiko kuti, −16k+16>0 ④ Saka k<1

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.1: Kana D>0, mutsetse unosangana ne curve mumapoinzi maviri akasiyana, saka hauna kubata. Kana D=0, k=1.

l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s2.model.0: Unofanira kuenda nenzira inopesana neslope, saka unobvisa, uye huwandu hwakafambwa ndi η chakawedzerwa ne f'(x), saka inova x−η f'(x).
l-m-h3-b0c36-23.s.s2.model.1: Kutanga panzvimbo yazvino x uye kubvisa η f'(x) kunoita kufamba kumwe chete nenhoroondo, saka ine zvinoreva zvakafanana.

l-m-h3-b0c38-15.material: Quiz score X inobuda se 1 point nemukana 0.2, 2 points ne 0.5, uye 3 points ne 0.3. Expected value i E(X)=1×0.2+2×0.5+3×0.3=2.1. Sarudza chimwe chirevo chine zvinoreva zvakafanana.

l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i mode. Expected value i weighted average.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.c: Iyi avhareji yakareruka isina kuremerwa nemukana.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.d: Avhareji kana vanhu 2, 5, ne3 pa10 vachiwana 1, 2, ne3 points
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.explain: Kana pavanhu 10, vanhu 2 vachiwana 1 point, 5 vachiwana 2 points, uye 3 vachiwana 3 points, avhareji i(2+10+9)÷10=2.1, yakafanana.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s2.model.0: Kushandura mikana kuita zvikamu zvevanhu kunopa (1×2+2×5+3×3)÷10=2.1, saka zvinoreva zvakafanana nekukosha kunotarisirwa.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s2.model.1: Kukosha kunotarisirwa iavhareji yakaremerwa nemukana, saka inopa kukosha kumwe chete neavhareji yevanhu 10 vemuzvikamu zvakafanana.

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.material: Kona rimwe retriangle yakaenzana ndi60° uye kona rimwe resikweya ndi90°. Pane pateni apo matriangle akaenzana 3 nemasikweya 2 anosangana pavertex imwe pasina mapindi.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.prompt: Equation ipi inoratidza kuti anosangana pasina mapindi?
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.a: Kana ukawedzera kona rega rega kamwe chete, ndi150°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.b: Wakachinjanisa nhamba dzezvimiro. Huwandu hwakakura kupfuura 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.d: Wakawedzera nhamba dzezvimiro chete, kwete hukuru hwemakona.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.explain: Makona anofanira kuwedzera kusvika pakutenderera kwakazara kwe360° kuti pasave nemapindi. 180°+180°=360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.0: Makona akatenderedza poindi anofanira kuva 360°, saka nyora kana 60°×3 pamwe ne90°×2 zvinoita 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.1: Inova 180°+180°=360°, saka equation inowanza kona rega rega nenhamba yezvimiro zvaro ukawedzera inoreva kuti anosangana pasina mapindi.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.material: Golden ratio φ (inenge 1.618) inosangana ne φ = 1 + 1/φ. Tsvaga imwe equation inoreva chinhu chimwe chete neiyi.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza equation inoreva chinhu chimwe chete neyepakutanga.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.c: Kana ukaparadza φ mumativi ese maviri, unowana 0=1, iri nhema.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.explain: Wedzera mativi ese maviri ne φ uye unowana φ² = φ + 1. Kana φ≈1.618, mativi ese maviri anenge 2.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.0: Kuwedzera mativi ese maviri ne φ kunopa φ²=φ+1, saka inoreva chinhu chimwe chete neequation yepakutanga.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.1: Kutsiva φ=1.618 kunopa φ²≈2.618 uye φ+1=2.618, saka maequation ese maviri anopa kukosha kwakafanana.

l-m-h3-b0c47-24.goal: Nyora patsva kuti huwandu hwemabhinya ehungwe hunokura sei semutemo wemutsetse mumwe nenzira imwe (equation, tafura, mufananidzo, kana mazwi), uye utsanangure kuti sei zvichireva chinhu chimwe chete.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.material: Bhinya rimwe rehungwe rinozvarwa, uye mushure memwedzi miviri rinowana bhinya idzva mwedzi wega wega. Hungwe hadzifi. Huwandu hwemabhinya mwedzi wega wega hunokura se 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ….
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.prompt: Ndechipi chinoshandura zvakarurama kukura uku kuva mutemo wemutsetse mumwe?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.a: Mwedzi uno = mwedzi wakapera × mwedzi wakapera
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.a: Kuwedzera kunopa 1, 1, 1, …. Izvo zvakasiyana nenhamba dzakapiwa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.b: Mwedzi uno = mwedzi wakapera + mwedzi miviri yapfuura
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.c: Inokura se 1, 2, 4, 8. Izvo zvakasiyana ne 1, 1, 2, 3 yakapiwa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.d: Inokura se 1, 2, 3, 4. Izvo zvakasiyana nenhamba dzakapiwa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwemapeya akazvarwa hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemapeya emwedzi miviri yapfuura. Saka 1+1=2, 1+2=3, 2+3=5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.0: Mapeya emwedzi uno i mapeya emwedzi wapfuura pamwe nemapeya akazvarwa, uye huwandu hwemapeya matsva hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemapeya emwedzi miviri yapfuura, saka mutemo uyu unoshanda.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.1: Kuwedzera nhamba mbiri dzakapfuura kunopa nhamba inotevera, sa 2+3=5 ne 3+5=8, saka mitemo miviri inoreva zvakafanana.

l-m-h3-b0c47-25.material: Isa pattern pa coordinate plane uye uitendeuke 180° kutenderera origin. Poinzi (3, 2) inoenda ku (−3, −2). Shandura kufamba uku kuita equation yepoinzi (x, y).

l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i symmetry pa x-axis. (3, 2) inoenda ku (3, −2).

l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.explain: Kutendeuka kwe 180° kunochinja zviratidzo zvose x ne y. Izvo zvinoenderana ne (3, 2) ichienda ku (−3, −2).
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s2.model.0: Sezvo (3, 2) ichienda ku (−3, −2), (−x, −y), inochinja zviratidzo zvose x ne y, i kufamba kumwechete.
l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s2.model.1: Symmetry pa y-axis kana x-axis inochinja chiratidzo chimwe chete, saka (3, 2) haiiti (−3, −2), uye hazvienderane.

l-m-h3-b0d07-05.title: Kushandura partial sum n/(n+1) kuva general term
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.goal: Taura general term aₙ yepartial sum Sₙ=n/(n+1) nenzira imwe (equation, tafura, mufananidzo, mazwi), uye utsanangure kuti sei zvichireva chinhu chimwe chete.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.material: Huwandu hwe series Σaₙ kubva kuterm yekutanga kusvika kuterm ye n ndi Sₙ=n/(n+1). Taura series imwe chete nengeneral term aₙ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.a: S₂−S₁=1/6, asi chirevo ichi chinopa a₂=2/3, saka chakasiyana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.explain: aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n=1/{n(n+1)}, uye inoshandawo kune n=1, ichipa 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.0: General term ndiwo musiyano wemapartial sums ari padyo, Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁, saka kuisa n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n padenominator imwe chete kunopa 1/{n(n+1)}.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.1: S₁=1/2 ne S₂−S₁=1/6, uye kuisa kukosha mu 1/{n(n+1)} kunopa 1/2 ne 1/6, saka ndiyo series imwe chete.

l-m-h3-b0d07-25.title: Kushandura nguva inokwira kuita inequality
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.goal: Taura nguva apo f(x)=x·e^(−x) inokwira nenzira yakasiyana (equation, tafura, mufananidzo, mazwi), uye utsanangure chikonzero nei zvichireva zvakafanana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.material: Kuti uwane nguva apo f(x)=x·e^(−x) inokwira, shandura f'(x)>0 kuita inequality yakareruka.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.prompt: Inequality ipi inoreva zvakafanana ne f'(x)>0?
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.b: Saini ye derivative ye e^(−x) yakashaikwa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange e^(−x) ichipositive, unofanira kutarisawo saini ye 1−x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.d: Saini yakapesana, saka nguva dzekukwira nekudzika dzakachinjana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.explain: f'(x)=e^(−x)−x e^(−x)=(1−x)e^(−x) uye e^(−x)>0, saka f'>0 zvinoreva 1−x>0, kureva x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.0: Nemutemo wemugumisiro f'(x)=(1−x)e^(−x), uye e^(−x) inogara iri positive, saka f'>0 yakafanana ne 1−x>0, kureva x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.1: Sezvo e^(−x)>0, saini inosarudzwa ne 1−x. Saka f'(x)>0 inoreva zvakafanana ne x<1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.0: Kuunganidza zvidimbu n zvine upamhi 2/n kunopa urefu 2, uye x=1+2k/n inobva ku1 kusvika ku3, saka ndi ∫₁³ f(x)dx.

l-m-h3-b0d09-06.material: Seti yemapoindi P(x, y) ari pachinhambwe chakaenzana kubva ku focus F(0, 2) ne directrix y = −2 iparabola. Shandura mamiriro aya kuita equation imwe chete.

l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.explain: Kuita sikweya mativi ese maviri e √(x²+(y−2)²)=|y+2| kunopa x²+y²−4y+4=y²+4y+4, kureva x²=8y.

l-m-h3-b0d09-24.material: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kona pavertex A yetriangle ABC ikona yakarurama sequation nemavector. Nyora mavector emativi AB ne AC.

l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s2.model.0: Kana kona pa A ikona yakarurama, AB ne AC dzakamira pamakona akarurama, saka dot product ndi AB·AC=|AB||AC|cos90°=0.

l-m-h3-b0d09-38.material: Equation yesphere yakatambanudzwa se x² + y² + z² − 2x + 4y − 6z + 5 = 0. Inyore patsva muchimiro umo pakati neradius zvinoonekwa nekukurumidza.

l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.b: Divi rekurudyi isquare yeradius, saka i9, kwete 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.c: Divi rekurudyi rakagadzirwa zvisiri izvo nekuwedzera constant term 5.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.explain: Completing the squares kunopa (x−1)²+(y+2)²+(z−3)²=1+4+9−5=9. Pakati i(1, −2, 3) uye radius i3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.0: Completing the square ye x, y, ne z imwe neimwe kunowedzera 1+4+9 uye kunotamisa 5, saka divi rekurudyi rinova 9, uye iequation imwe chete.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.1: Kutamisa divi rekurudyi 9 kuruboshwe uye kutambanudza kunopa −2x+4y−6z neconstant 1+4+9−9=5, saka zvakafanana neequation yekutanga.

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.goal: Enzanisa nzira mbiri dzekusarudza mabhuku ane kuravira kwakafanana, sarudza yakakodzera zvakanyanya, uye utsanangure kufunga kwako.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.material: Kuravira ndi s=(1,2), Bhuku X=(1,2), uye Bhuku Y=(6,0). Nzira A inosarudza bhuku rine dot product huru, uye Nzira B inosarudza bhuku rine cosine similarity cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|) huru. Chinangwa ibhuku rine 'nzira' imwe chete nekuravira.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.prompt: Nzira ipi yakakodzera zvakanyanya kuchinangwa chekutsvaga bhuku rine nzira imwe chete?
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.a: A: Sarudza bhuku rine dot product huru zvikuru
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.a: Dot product inokura kana vectors dzichikura, saka haigoni kuenzanisa nzira yoga.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.b: Nzira A inosarudza Y uye Nzira B inosarudza X, saka dzakasiyana.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.c: B: Govera nehukuru uye uenzanise nzira chete
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.d: A: Bhuku rine hukuru hwakakura rinogara riri nani
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.d: Hukuru hahuna chekuita nekuti rinowirirana sei nekuravira.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.explain: X ine nzira imwe chete ne s, saka cos=1, uye Y inenge 0.45. Dot product inorata Y, iri hombe muhukuru, kwakanyanya, saka haiwirirani nechinangwa chenzira.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.0: Cosine similarity inogovera nehukuru uye inoenzanisa nzira chete, saka inosarudza X, ine nzira imwe chete ne s, uye inowirirana nechinangwa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.1: Dot product yakabuda yakakwira pa6 nekuti Y yakakura, asi nzira yayo yakasiyana, saka kana nzira iri chinangwa, B ndiyo yakakodzera.

l-m-h3-b0c47-26.goal: Enzanisa ma ancient approximations maviri e pi, sarudza iri padyo ne π, uye utsanangure kufunga kwako.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.material: Pi (π) i 3.14159…. Nzira yeEgypt yekare yakatora π se 256/81 (anenge 3.1605), uye nzira yeBabylon yakaitora se 25/8 (=3.125).
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.a: Mitengo miviri iri kure zvakaenzana ne π
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.a: Misiyano ne π yakasiyana: anenge 0.0189 ne 0.0166.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.b: Musiyano ne π i mukuru pa 3.1605, anenge 0.0189.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.c: Babylon (3.125): musiyano ne π i mudiki
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.o.d: Iyo yeEgypt, ine fraction yakaoma, ine accuracy yakakura
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.r.d: Kuoma hakuite kuti ive nyatsonaka. Unofanira kuenzanisa misiyano.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s1.explain: Misiyano ne π=3.14159 i anenge 0.0189 yeEgypt uye anenge 0.0166 yeBabylon, saka mutengo weBabylon uri padyo zvishoma.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s2.model.0: 3.1605−3.14159≈0.0189 ne 3.14159−3.125≈0.0166, uye 0.0166 i diki, saka mutengo weBabylon uri padyo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-26.s.s2.model.1: 3.125 i diki kupfuura π uye 3.1605 i yakakura kupfuura π. Kuenzanisa kuti imwe neimwe iri kure zvakadini, yeBabylon i diki, saka iri padyo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.o.d: Vose vakarurama. 2sin x cos x = sin 2x

l-m-h3-b0d07-27.title: Limit ye (e^(3x)−1)/x: ndiani akarurama?
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.goal: Enzanisa nzira kana zvirevo zviviri nezve limit ye (e^(3x)−1)/x kana x→0, sarudza inowirirana zvirinani, uye utsanangure kufunga kwako.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.material: A anoti lim(x→0)(e^(3x)−1)/x ndi3, uye B anoti ndi1. A: Regai 3x=t, uchichinja kuita 3·(eᵗ−1)/t. B: Sezvo (eʰ−1)/h→1, ndi1 chete.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.o.a: B akarurama. Fomula yelimit inoshandiswa zvakananga.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.r.a: Nhamba yekuzasi ndi x, saka haina chimiro che (eʰ−1)/h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.r.c: Kana x=0.001, mutengo unenge 3.0045, uri padyo ne3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.o.d: A akarurama. Nhamba yekuzasi inoenderanawo ne3x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.explain: e^(3x)−1 ine chimiro apo 3x inoita basa re h, saka nhamba yekuzasi inofanirawo kuva 3x. 3·(e^(3x)−1)/(3x)→3·1=3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s2.model.0: Nhamba yekuzasi inofanira kuva 3x kuti uwane chimiro che (eʰ−1)/h, saka kuwanza nekugovera ne3 kunopa 3·1=3, izvo zvinoita A akarurama.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s2.model.1: Kana x=0.001, (e^0.003−1)/0.001≈3.0045, iri padyo ne3, saka 1 yaB haina kururama uye 3 yaA yakarurama.

l-m-h3-b0d07-33.material: Kune ∫₋₁¹ (1/x²)dx, A anoti [−1/x]₋₁¹=(−1)−(1)=−2, uye B anoti 'sezvo 1/x² isina kutsanangurwa pa x=0, nzira iyi haigoni kushandiswa.'

l-m-h3-b0d07-33.s.s1.explain: 1/x² inoputsika pa x=0, saka haienderere panguva. Inogara iri positive, asi mutengo ndi−2, izvo zvinopokana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-33.s.s2.model.0: Fundamental Theorem inogona kushandiswa chete kana basa richienderera panguva, asi 1/x² inoputsika pa x=0, saka mutengo −2 waA haugoni kuvimbwa.
